    ProfileYieldsDisjoint = fun (n k : nat) (B : nat -> nat) => forall (m : nat) (F : Family), 1 <= m -> m <= n -> Uniform m F -> Distinct F -> B m < length F -> ProfileSpread B m F -> exists S : list (list nat), List.incl S F /\ List.NoDup S /\ length S = k /\ PairwiseDisjoint S : nat -> nat -> (nat -> nat) -> Prop Arguments ProfileYieldsDisjoint (n k)%nat_scope B%function_scope
